name: Central-heating boiler
definition: appliance that heats water for a home's radiators or underfloor circuit; heating-only or combi is a function attribute, fuel a tag, and a combi boiler pack is a unit-of-sale attribute (section 14).

name: Furnace
definition: warm-air heating plant that heats air and sends it through ducts; fuel is a tag (B7-O1).

name: Panel radiator
definition: flat-panel heat emitter, usually fed by hot water.

name: Column radiator
definition: heat emitter built of upright columns or sections; material and era are attributes.

name: Towel radiator [Badheizkörper]
definition: heated rail made to warm and dry towels in a bathroom; hot-water or electric is a power attribute.

name: Fan heater
definition: room heater that blows air over a heating element; fuel is a tag.

name: Convector heater
definition: room heater that warms air by natural convection over an element.

name: Oil-filled radiator
definition: portable electric heater with sealed oil-filled fins.

name: Radiant heater
definition: heater with an exposed bar, quartz or halogen element and reflector (split from the panel heater by form, provisional).

name: Infrared panel heater
definition: flat wall- or ceiling-hung panel that heats by infrared radiation; picture-motif prints are variants.

name: Infrared heat lamp
definition: lamp sold as a heater, not a bulb sold as a part.

name: Flued stove
definition: solid-fuel stove with a firebox vented through a flue (rule T(b), provisional until a fetched source ranks it apart).

name: Flueless room heater
definition: kerosene or gas room heater with no flue (rule T(b), provisional as above).

name: Flued fire
definition: inset or wall-hung fire vented through a flue; fuel is a tag (B7-O1; rule T(b), provisional).

name: Underfloor heating kit
definition: electric mat or hydronic pipe kit sold to heat a floor (B7-O1).

name: Hydronic heat pump
definition: air-to-water heat pump that heats water for radiators or a floor; heat source is an attribute.

name: Ground-source heat pump
definition: heat pump drawing heat from a ground loop, a kind whatever it delivers (B-24).

name: Wall-mounted split air conditioner [mini-split heat pump; 挂机]
definition: indoor wall unit linked by refrigerant lines to an outdoor unit; reversible is a tag.

name: Floor-standing air conditioner [柜机]
definition: split air conditioner whose indoor unit stands on the floor as a cabinet.

name: Ceiling-cassette air conditioner
definition: split air conditioner whose indoor unit is set into the ceiling.

name: Window air conditioner
definition: single-box unit fitted in a window or wall opening.

name: Portable air conditioner
definition: movable single-box unit venting through a hose.

name: Ducted or central system [中央空调]
definition: multi-split or ducted plant cooling several rooms, a ducted heat pump included.

name: Desk fan
definition: small fan made to stand on a desk or table.

name: Stationary fan [pedestal fan]
definition: fan on a stand or pedestal of adjustable height.

name: Tower fan
definition: tall, narrow fan blowing through a vertical grille.

name: Wall or clip fan
definition: fan made to mount on a wall or clip to an edge (body test against the desk fan provisional, C12(a)).

name: Handheld fan
definition: powered hand-held or neck fan; a manual hand fan is A4 (K-133).

name: Air circulator
definition: fan made to move air round a whole room in a focused stream.

name: Ceiling fan
definition: fan hung from the ceiling, with or without a light.

name: Ventilating fan [extractor fan]
definition: fan fitted to draw stale air out of a room.

name: Ventilation unit
definition: ventilation unit for a room or home, with or without heat recovery.

name: Air purifier
definition: appliance that filters particles and pollutants from room air; tower or desktop and filter grade are attributes.

name: Humidifier
definition: appliance that adds moisture to room air; mechanism (ultrasonic, evaporative, warm mist) is an attribute (B-25).

name: Portable dehumidifier
definition: movable appliance that draws moisture from room air.

name: Whole-house dehumidifier
definition: dehumidifier installed to treat a whole home, usually ducted.

name: Mini dehumidifier
definition: small-capacity dehumidifier; Peltier is a technology attribute.

name: Deodoriser
definition: appliance made to remove odours from room air.

name: Ion generator
definition: appliance that releases ions into room air.

name: Desiccant moisture absorber
definition: unpowered container of desiccant that absorbs room moisture (K-11).

name: Thermostat
definition: device that switches heating or cooling to hold a set temperature; smart or plain is a connectivity attribute, and a smart radiator head is filed here.

name: Storage water heater [tank water heater]
definition: water heater that heats and holds water in its own tank.

name: Tankless water heater [instant water heater]
definition: water heater that heats water on demand as it flows.

name: Heat-pump water heater
definition: water heater that heats water with a compressor heat pump (C10(b), CV-24).

name: Solar water heater
definition: system that heats household water from solar collectors.

name: Solar thermal collector
definition: flat-plate or evacuated-tube collector sold on its own (B7-O1).

name: Point-of-use water heater
definition: small water heater fitted at one tap or outlet.

name: Hot-water cylinder
definition: indirect or buffer tank heated by a boiler, with no heat source of its own (B7-O1; provisional until attested as a retail kind).

name: Water softener
definition: unit that removes hardness from the home supply; salt-based or salt-free is a technology attribute.

name: Plumbed water filter
definition: filter plumbed to the supply or fitted to a tap; whole-house, under-sink, shower or tap-mounted is an installation attribute (a jug filter is B5).

name: Reverse-osmosis system
definition: unit that purifies water through a reverse-osmosis membrane.

name: UV water treatment system
definition: unit that disinfects water with ultraviolet light.

name: Distiller
definition: appliance that purifies water by boiling and condensing it.

name: Bathtub
definition: fixed or freestanding tub for bathing in; era and material are attributes.

name: Shower
definition: shower unit or set for washing under running water; power source is an attribute (electric shower provisional as a kind only on a ranking source).

name: Washbasin
definition: basin for washing hands and face; sold built into its cabinet is an attribute (K-184).

name: Cistern-flush toilet [water closet]
definition: toilet flushed by water from a cistern.

name: Waterless or composting toilet
definition: toilet that uses no flush water, composting or storing the waste.

name: Bidet
definition: separate low basin for washing the lower body.

name: Warm-water toilet seat [bidet seat; Washlet]
definition: powered toilet seat with a warm-water wash (rule R, C11).

name: Hard-shell hot tub
definition: hot tub with a moulded rigid shell and built-in heater and pumps; construction material is an attribute (B-26; provisional).

name: Inflatable hot tub
definition: portable hot tub with an inflatable body and plug-in heater pump (B-26; provisional).

name: Wood-fired hot tub
definition: wooden tub heated by a wood-burning stove (B-26; provisional, mapping checked at harvest).

name: Portable sauna
definition: sauna that is set up or folded inside a home, not a cabin standing as a building (K-64).

name: Solar panel
definition: photovoltaic module that turns sunlight into electricity.

name: Plug-in balcony solar kit [Balkonkraftwerk]
definition: panel plus micro-inverter sold as one set to plug into a home socket and feed the grid, with no storage (B-25, S3a).

name: Off-grid solar kit
definition: panels, charge controller or inverter and usually a battery, sold as one kit to power a place without a grid connection; RV, van, boat and cabin are use tags (section 14; provisional until the kit page itself is fetched).

name: Small wind turbine
definition: wind turbine sized to generate power for a home or site.

name: Inverter
definition: device that converts DC from panels or batteries to household AC.

name: Charge controller
definition: device that regulates charging of a battery from solar panels.

name: Home battery
definition: rechargeable battery that stores electricity for a home; the portable power station (battery and inverter in one carried box) is its portable form (K-157; provisional as a retail kind).

name: Energy meter or monitor
definition: device that measures and shows a home's electricity use or generation.

name: Replacement air filter
definition: filter made to fit a purifier, humidifier or dehumidifier (S3).

name: Softener salt
definition: salt used up in a water softener (S3, K-11; dishwasher salt is B6).

name: Replacement filter cartridge
definition: cartridge made to fit a water filter or treatment unit (S3, K-11).

name: Solar panel mount
definition: mounting frame or bracket made for solar panels (S3).
